description.p: CrabyTube is a native player for YouTube Music. It needs no browser, no Electron and no account.

ul.li: Search, Home with recent searches and collections, and your favorite songs
Queue with shuffle and repeat, and a radio from any song
Synced lyrics that follow the playback
Media keys and desktop media controls (MPRIS)

description.p: Podcasts: search finds podcasts and their episodes, a podcast opens on its episodes with their dates and lengths, and long episodes start at once and seek anywhere in them. Lengths of an hour or more read as hours.

Playlists: Favorite songs and your own lists in a Library, a Save to panel on every heart, covers from your computer and dragging to reorder; a Home that fits the window with Jump back in, All-time essentials and Your lists; artist pages with albums, singles and artists alike; notes with Undo; Up next reordered by dragging; and a layout for phone-width windows with the tabs at the foot.

A tray icon on Windows and macOS, updates offered in the Flatpak, and Discord Rich Presence that finds Discord, its Flatpak, Snap and Vesktop and says when Discord refuses the activity. Also fixes for playback, the media controls, the seek bar and lyrics.

Closing the window keeps CrabyTube in the tray, and Open in the tray brings the window back to the front on Wayland. Also fixes for search, instrumental tracks, the media controls and saving settings.
